pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large irregular polygons with high-frequency jagged edges and sharp pixel gradients. Geometric area is maximal on the mid-flank, exhibiting significant compression and reduced spatial area as the pattern approaches the dorsal ridge.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-tan network with consistent pixel width across the mid-flank. Topological junctions are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. High-contrast negative space forming a complete graph across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Fine-grained, high-frequency serration along the upper neck and shoulder silhouette. Mane hair creates a dark, low-amplitude jagged contour against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant vertical out-of-focus occlusion (foreground vegetation) obscuring the pixel data of the posterior flank and hindquarters.
